title: HEICO CORPORATION ANNOUNCES REGULAR QUARTERLY CONFERENCE CALL

body_markdown:
HOLLYWOOD, FL AND MIAMI, FL **** – HEICO Corporation (NYSE:HEI.A, HEI) On August 25, 2026, after the NYSE closing, HEICO Corporation (NYSE:HEI.A)(NYSE:HEI) will release its financial results for the third quarter ended July 31, 2026. The earnings release will be available through the Internet on the Company’s website at[https://www.heico.com](https://pr.report/oznm) .
